correctness.rationale: Exact BFS-distance logic: vertex-vertex and facet-facet distances are 2 except antipodal/opposite 4, and vertex-facet distance is 1 if incident or 3 otherwise. At scale1 the connected bipartite graph is one-dimensional with cycle rank (d-1)2^d-2d+1. At scale2, each compatible facet set F has cube fiber X_F of size 2^{d-|F|} forming a simplex; decreasing-|F| then decreasing-|U| free-face deletions of F∪U⊂F∪U∪{a_F} remove every facet-containing simplex, leaving the antipodal-pair cross-polytope join, sphere dimension 2^{d-1}-1. At scale3 all cross X-Y pairs appear and the exact join has sphere dimension 2^{d-1}+d-1; scale4 full simplex. Persistence follows from different nonzero homology dimensions for d>=3. Independent BFS and exhaustive 2^14 subset clique checks for d=3 recovered 240 and 2186 nonempty scale2/3 faces, and inspected actual exact d=3,4 free-collapse verifier script. Analytic all-d collapse establishes infinite theorem.
